about.description: XGZ is a gold token from GoldZip Digital, the Singapore subsidiary of the Hong Kong Gold Exchange, with each token backed by 1 gram of 99.99% gold in HKGX-recognized vaults and redeemable for physical bars subject to AML checks. The token trades on Uniswap and MEXC. Roughly 95% of the 39,000-token supply remains in the issuer treasury, and reserve audits have not yet been published.
about.registryInfo: GoldZip Digital Pte. Ltd., Singapore registered precious-metals dealer (MinLaw), subsidiary of the Hong Kong Gold Exchange (HKGX, the former Chinese Gold & Silver Exchange, trading physical gold since 1910). Web3 partner: Midas Labs (May 2026). HKGX states member gold inventory is "currently in audit" - no published auditor report; ~95% of supply sits in issuer treasury.
